summary.intent: Evaluate how well the wisp-plugins set worked for front-end work and design ideation by analyzing past orin-dx/techworx sessions, then (after the v5 rework) finish the v5 migration: make docs use-focused and scannable, update diagrams, and bring mason, the constitution and authoring rules to the v5 model.
summary.outcome: Four investigations found the old spec/gate plugins too rigid for exploratory design work and missing visual capability. The v5 docs, READMEs, diagrams, mason (5.0.0) and authoring rules were then rewritten by parallel agents, verified with `just check` and `just mermaid`, and pushed as `chore/v5-docs-and-mason` with Entire trail #419, plus a follow-up README links commit.

repo: The old plugin set was a spec-driven lifecycle (weaver, vanguard, scribe/muse, navigator, smith, courier) with default-fail gates and typed JSON handoffs in shared/schemas; it had no browser, screenshot, visual or generative mode.

Plugin agents appeared in only a few top-level sessions of ~810 files; the rest were subagent transcripts. Design ideation ran through Artifacts, forks, general-purpose agents and local dev servers with Playwright screenshots, not plugins.
muse docs referenced a ranger accessibility taxonomy that never existed, so implemented a11y was never checked.
spec@1 has no fields for tokens, layout, breakpoints or visual references, so specs could pass the gate while saying nothing about appearance.

Gates verified spec internal consistency and caught real behavioural defects (contrast, cross-spec contradictions, stale breakpoints), but visual defects were found only by the user's eye or later audits.

Sync tools (`just claude-manifests-sync`, `just marketplace-sync`) regenerate marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and dist/codex; `just check` and `just mermaid` are the verification commands.
Published schemas are immutable, so ~35 schemas for the deleted pipeline remain; plan@1 still has an unproduced spec_hash field.
The validate-handback hook denies invalid handbacks up to 3 times per agent (MAX_DENIALS = 3), RETRY_CAP = 1, and routes only wisp:verifier.
ARCHITECTURE.md anchors the README depends on: #2-how-a-request-flows-through-wisp, #5-hooks-and-where-they-run, #6-packs, #8-cross-harness-distribution, plus CONTRIBUTING.md#releasing.

code.finding: Docstring and a comment claimed muse registers the handback hook/has an exit gate; in v5 muse has no hooks and ROUTES lists only wisp:verifier. Fixed in the worktree.
Pre-v5 'Cognitive Modes' table said 'do not combine modes'; replaced with a context-or-risk split section.

workflow: Splitting docs work across parallel agents with file ownership caused overlap (v5-docs edited the root README before the scope change reached it); explicit ownership and anchor-stability messages between agents resolved it.
Agents finished edits after the commit (README link additions), so checking `git status` for post-commit changes before declaring done was necessary.
Subagent reports were treated as unverified claims; hook facts were re-checked against the source before being trusted.

friction: Initial session count was wrong (~810 files, but only a handful were real top-level sessions; the rest were subagent transcripts).
Agents stalled on 60-130 KB spec/plan files; exit-gate loops churned on wording-only blockers and the orchestrator bypassed the 3-retry escalation without asking the user.
Specs could not be judged without rendered visuals, and the user had to ask repeatedly to be shown pictures.
Design decisions were lost across sessions with no decision persistence.
Docs agent and README agent overlapped on README.md edits.
Pages PR #45 was opened with `gh` against that repo's own rule, and the classifier denied earlier cleanup actions.

Merge trail #416 first, then #419; approve the repo migration PRs (Callisto, Monokl, Caliper, Pages) and run `just release` for 5.0.0.
Verify Codex and Antigravity install lines, the .claude/settings.json snippet and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} on Antigravity; quick-start examples are made up.
Queued wisp tweaks (load references by mode, mention packs in work, reword Stop-hook line), Entire findings cleanup on trail #386, deleting merged remote branches, and listing stale trails.
Measure v5 after a week or two of use with tools/transcript-metrics.py; make pack taste calls (expect/panic!, camino, any in TS, third house pack).
The evaluate skill cites docs/evaluation-runbook.md, which does not ship with the plugin.
